name: Apple
description: A whole fruit that can be eaten with little or no preparation.
whyItMatters: Whole fruits provide fiber, vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients without extensive processing.
everydayTip: Keep apples available as an easy snack.

name: Carrots
description: A simple vegetable that can be eaten raw, cooked, or added to meals.
whyItMatters: Vegetables can provide fiber and important vitamins and minerals while requiring little processing.
everydayTip: Wash and cut carrots ahead of time for quick snacks.

name: Plain Oats
description: Plain oats are a simple grain that can be prepared with milk, yogurt, fruit, or other foods.
whyItMatters: Plain oats provide fiber and are less processed than many flavored instant breakfast products.
everydayTip: Choose plain oats and add fruit for natural sweetness.

name: Frozen Vegetables
description: Frozen vegetables are cleaned and frozen to preserve them for later use.
whyItMatters: Frozen vegetables can make it easier to include vegetables in meals without adding many ingredients.
everydayTip: Keep a bag of frozen vegetables available for quick meals.

name: Plain Yogurt
description: Plain yogurt is made from milk fermented with live cultures.
whyItMatters: Plain yogurt can provide protein and calcium without the added sugars found in many flavored varieties.
everydayTip: Add fruit or oats to plain yogurt for flavor and texture.

name: Eggs
description: Eggs are a minimally processed source of protein that can be prepared in many ways.
whyItMatters: Eggs provide protein and several nutrients while requiring very little processing.
everydayTip: Prepare boiled eggs ahead of time for a convenient protein-rich snack.

name: Canned Chickpeas
description: Canned chickpeas are cooked and preserved with water and usually some salt.
whyItMatters: They are more processed than dried chickpeas but can still be a convenient source of plant protein and fiber.
everydayTip: Rinse canned chickpeas to reduce excess sodium.

name: Canned Tuna
description: Canned tuna is preserved to make it convenient and shelf-stable.
whyItMatters: It can provide protein and other nutrients, although some varieties contain added salt or oil.
everydayTip: Compare labels and choose options with ingredients you recognize.

name: Cheese
description: Cheese is made by processing milk with cultures, enzymes, and other ingredients depending on the variety.
whyItMatters: Cheese can provide protein and calcium, but processing and sodium levels vary between products.
everydayTip: Use cheese as part of a balanced meal rather than relying on it as the main ingredient.

name: Whole-Grain Bread
description: Whole-grain bread is made by combining and baking several basic ingredients.
whyItMatters: Whole grains can provide more fiber and nutrients than refined-grain breads.
everydayTip: Check the ingredient list and look for whole grains near the beginning.

name: Natural Peanut Butter
description: Natural peanut butter is made primarily from ground peanuts.
whyItMatters: Products with a short ingredient list can be a simple way to include nuts and seeds in the diet.
everydayTip: Look for peanut butter with little or no added sugar.

name: Sweetened Breakfast Cereal
mainIngredients: Refined grains, sugar, flavorings, and additives
description: Many sweetened breakfast cereals contain refined ingredients, added sugars, flavorings, and additives.
whyItMatters: Highly processed cereals can make it easy to consume large amounts of added sugar without feeling very full.
everydayTip: Compare cereals and consider choosing options with less added sugar and more fiber.

name: Packaged Cookies
mainIngredients: Refined flour, sugar, fats, flavorings, and additives
description: Packaged cookies are manufactured using several refined ingredients and additives.
whyItMatters: They are designed for convenience and taste but may contain substantial amounts of added sugar and refined fats.
everydayTip: Enjoy them occasionally and balance snacks with whole or minimally processed foods.

name: Soft Drink
mainIngredients: Carbonated water, sweeteners, acids, flavorings, and additives
description: Soft drinks are formulated beverages that commonly contain added sugar or non-sugar sweeteners.
whyItMatters: Sugary drinks can add a significant amount of sugar without providing much nutritional value.
everydayTip: Choose water more often and keep soft drinks as an occasional choice.

name: Instant Noodles
mainIngredients: Refined wheat flour, oils, salt, seasonings, and additives
description: Instant noodles are manufactured for quick preparation and often include seasoning packets with many ingredients.
whyItMatters: They can be high in sodium and may provide fewer nutrients than meals built from less processed ingredients.
everydayTip: Add vegetables and a protein source if you choose instant noodles.

name: Chicken Nuggets
mainIngredients: Chicken, coating, oils, starches, seasonings, and additives
description: Chicken nuggets are manufactured products made from chicken and a variety of coating and processing ingredients.
whyItMatters: They can contain more sodium, refined ingredients, and additives than less processed chicken preparations.
everydayTip: Choose simply prepared chicken more often when possible.

name: Hot Dog
mainIngredients: Processed meat, water, salt, seasonings, and additives
description: Hot dogs are processed meat products made with meat and additional ingredients for flavor, texture, and preservation.
whyItMatters: Processed meats can contain significant amounts of sodium and other ingredients used during manufacturing.
everydayTip: Enjoy processed meats less often and vary your protein sources.

name: Chocolate Bar
mainIngredients: Sugar, cocoa, fats, milk ingredients, flavorings, and additives
description: Packaged chocolate bars often combine cocoa with added sugar, fats, flavorings, and other ingredients.
whyItMatters: Chocolate bars can be high in added sugar and energy while providing limited nutritional value depending on the product.
everydayTip: Enjoy chocolate in moderation and consider options with a higher cocoa content.
